# Destination reached!

Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Installed and configured the Grafana Terraform provider for infrastructure as code
- Set up SAML authentication with external group synchronization for automated user access
- Applied custom RBAC roles for granular feature permissions
- Configured label-based access controls to restrict data visibility
- Created teams that automatically sync with your identity provider groups
- Configured data sources with team-specific query permissions
- Built dashboard folders with least privilege access controls
- Implemented alert rules, contact points, and notification routing as code
- Deployed and updated your Grafana Cloud configuration using Terraform workflows
- Verified team access and permissions work as designed

You now have a fully configured Grafana Cloud environment managed entirely as code. Your configuration is version-controlled, reproducible, and can be deployed consistently across multiple environments. This foundation enables your teams to collaborate effectively while maintaining strong security boundaries.
